en:
Now that Gonta's gone...I wonder what's going to
happen to all the bugs in his research lab.
I don't think we could deal with them...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Tsumugi for a while?

It makes me feel bad, but let's 
just leave them alone...
I wonder if Gonta would get mad...
<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some quiet time with Tsumugi...
<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi and I grew a little closer today.
